lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Wall A/wall B 90 deg corner fold. In sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the outer convex skin, 0.03-0.11 mm from the surface. The line runs the full wall-to-wall fold between the two lip corners.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Wall A outward top lip (7/8), ~90 deg. The label is on the outer apex in all three sections (nn 0.03-0.12 mm). It spans the lip base from the B1 corner to the lip's far end.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Wall A outward bottom lip (5/9/15/18), drawn correctly as one fold through the embossed hole bosses. The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.02-0.13 mm). Its end coincides with the lip's end edge, checked in a close regional render, and it starts at the corner.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Wall A inward top tab (16/17), ~90 deg, folded opposite to B2 (opposite wall outer skin). The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.08-0.17 mm) and spans the full ~16 mm tab base.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Wall A end return tab with an embossed hole, ~90 deg. The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.13-0.17 mm) and spans the full ~11 mm tab base in face-on and oblique views.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Wall B outward top lip (13/14), ~90 deg. The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.01-0.06 mm) and spans the full ~27 mm lip base, from the corner to the relief gap before B7. It is a separate fold from B7 because the two are bent in opposite directions.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Wall B inward top lip (11/12) with two holes, ~90 deg. The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.03-0.18 mm) and spans the full lip base.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Wall B outward bottom lip (6/10/19/20), drawn correctly as one fold through the hole bosses. The label is on the outer apex (nn 0.01-0.11 mm) and spans from the corner to the lip end.

lines.label: B9
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1 of 2 (~50 deg) at wall B's lanced end tab. The S-section shows the label on the convex skin of the first ramp bend (nn 0.04-0.21 mm). The extent override runs from the inner end of the lance slit to the tab's bottom edge, which is the full tab width.

lines.label: B10
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2 of 2 (~50 deg), a distinct line ~4.5 mm from B9. The label is on the convex skin of the second ramp bend (nn 0.04-0.09 mm) and spans from the slit to the bottom edge, the full tab width.
